As,Ⓒconj., adv.ⒹEx. by vat, iva; mAtfvat-mAtaramiva-paradArAn paSya.
Ⓑ
 2 yaTA, yadvat, anurUpaM-peRa; yaTA in comp. (yaToktaM kaTaya); ‘as-so’ yaTA-taTA with or without eva ‘as-as’ yaTEva-taTEva (yaTEva SAMtA taTEva sItA daSaraTasya priyA) (U. 4). ‘as since-therefore’ taTA-taTA, yataH-tataH, yat-tat; ‘as for instance’, yaTA (yaTA mahAnase), or taTAhi.
Ⓑ
 2 (On account of) ex. by abl. or instr. of noun.
Ⓑ
 3 (While) yAvat-tAvat; or by pres. part.; ‘as he was going, he thought’ gacCan sa itTaM manasi cakAra; ‘as high as’ daGna (GnI f.), mAtra, in comp.; ‘water as high as the knee’ jAnudaGnaM jalaM; UrumAtrA BittiH &c.; ‘as soon as’ yAvat-tAvat; or loc. abs. constr. with mAtra or eva; ‘as he had spoken’ uktavatyeva tasmin; ‘as before’, yaTApurA, yaTApUrvaM, pUrvavat; ‘as far as’ yAvat with acc., A with abl. or in comp. (AsamudrakzitISAnAM) ‘as if’, ‘as it were’ iva; oft. by man 4 A; ‘as if the city had been a large tank’ nagaraM mahAkAsAraM manyamAnaH; ‘as follows’ iti (iti vaktaM pracakrame), or ex. by yaTA-yat at the beginning of narratives; ‘it is as follows’ tadyaTA; ‘as to’, ‘as for’ tu, tAvat, iti, aDikftya, uddiSya; ‘as for ments, he has none’ guRAstAvattasya nEva vidyate; ‘as for doing it quickly it is easy’ SIGramiti sukaraM (niBftamiti tu ciMtanIyaM S. 3), ‘as well as’ ca-ca; ‘as many as’ ‘as much as’ yAvat-tAvat; ‘as yet’ adyApi, adya yAvat.
Ⓑ
 4 (Connecting words in apposition) ex. by iti; sa baMDuriti mataH, baMDurmataH ‘as a father he respects me’ piteti mAM sa mAnayati.
